title: Full self-attention is expensive for very long sequences
description: Standard self-attention considers all pairs of positions, which becomes computationally prohibitive for very long sequences. The paper notes that restricting attention to a local neighborhood would improve efficiency for such cases.
canonical_description: full self-attention computationally expensive for long sequences

evidence.quote: To improve computational performance for tasks involving very long sequences, self-attention could be restricted to considering only a neighborhood of size r in the input sequence centered around the respective output position. This would increase the maximum path length to O(n/r). We plan to investigate this approach further in future work.
